components.name: Countdown LCD

narrative.overview: Every question is a pen trace against a trip line. The housing keeps its colors; the panel re-tunes; the paper stays paper in both themes.
keyCharacteristics: One world, a recorder: housing, paper, pen, trip line, LCD, lamps.
The chart's vertical scale is the points curve.
The paper is paper in both themes; the housing is dark in both.
Result marks differ by shape as well as color.
Amber belongs to the countdown alone.

rules.name: The Paper Stays Paper Rule
rules.body: The recorder paper is light in both themes and the ink on it keeps its day values.

rules.name: The Countdown Owns Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on the LCD.

rules.name: The Recorder, Not a Market Rule
rules.body: No tickers, prices, arrows, candles, or green-up red-down gains around the pen.

rules.name: The Tabular Everything Rule
rules.body: Tabular numerals are on at body.

rules.name: The Housing Rim Rule
rules.body: A dark panel gets its edge from the 1px white inset rim, never a border.

dos: Do keep the chart scale equal to the points curve.
Do give a result a shape and a word or number as well as a color.
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use pale-on-black chart styling or market cues.
Don't put emoji in the interface; they belong in the share text only.
